description: A tunnel to member to: passed on to the next host on the way (ttl hosts at most), as it came, and at to a connection to its host process, served as if a head had connected to its socket, from the member that signed it; closed there if it has no from, or isn't signed as from's key, now and once.

t.description: The tunnel, by the number of the end that opened it (this end's).

sender.description: Who what's sent through it is from (relay's as).

signed.description: JSON of {to, from, time (in seconds), nonce, sender}, as the member that opened it signed it: what's taken of who it's from where it's opened to.

sig.description: signed's Ed25519 signature, by from's key, in base64.
